android.desc:
Overdrop: the most beautiful weather widget app offering comprehensive forecasts, customizable themes, and real-time radar. enjoy 70+ gorgeous widgets that seamlessly integrate with your device while tracking essential metrics.

STUNNING WIDGETS & CUSTOMIZATION

- 70+ beautiful widgets displaying essential weather data through visually appealing designs
- 12 immersive themes with stunning animations: light, ataraxia, neo-hinode, fallout, relacsio, trailbreeze, bubbly, serenity, realistic, amoled, space, and tranquillity
- Fully customizable ui with adjustable colors matching weather illustrations based on current conditions
- Personalized icon packs complementing your chosen theme and weather displays

COMPREHENSIVE WEATHER DATA

- Detailed forecasts providing hourly and extended 7-day predictions
- Live weather radar and storm tracker monitoring developing conditions in real time
- Complete atmospheric readings including temperature, wind, pressure, and more
- Multiple trusted providers like openweathermap, weatherbit, and foreca ensuring superior accuracy
- Weather alerts with critical notifications for severe conditions and important changes
- Air quality index and uv monitoring helping you plan outdoor activities safely

ADVANCED FEATURES

- Unlimited location tracking to monitor weather anywhere worldwide
- Interactive weather maps displaying various meteorological conditions and patterns
- Precise measurements showing current and "feels like" readings with daily highs and lows
- Precipitation forecasting with probability and intensity metrics for rain, snow, and storms
- Comprehensive meteorological data presented through beautifully animated visual indicators
- UV index levels helping you stay protected outdoors
- Air quality monitoring with pollutant breakdowns for health-conscious users
